title: 30th October – Diwali Party
summary: On 30th October, our Club had organised a Diwali Party from 7 pm onwards at Orient Club, Chowpatty.
description:
On 30th October, our Club had organised a Diwali Party from 7 pm onwards at Orient Club, Chowpatty. It was a memorable evening of festive cheer, music with renowned singer, delicious food, gifts and great fellowship as one Rotary family.
The food was sponsored by PE Rtn Tehemton Dalal, Gifts were courtesy Rtn Kishore Chokhani. The evening was lovingly put together by Rtn Kishore Chokhani and ably supported by Rtn Asma Batliwala.
It was a memorable evening of festive cheer and fellowship.
Attended by 28 Members and 11 Partners taking the total to 39
